frames.label: The EUR discount curve sells off through the belly
frames.note: Four basis points at five years, tapering into the wings. The meeting-dated ESTR curve discounts every EUR trade and feeds the EURIBOR and cross currency builds, so this carries into both

frames.label: The comparison ESTR curve moves
frames.note: The tenor OIS build of ESTR is kept for comparison and nothing prices on it. The curve rebuilds and the book does not move

frames.label: SONIA steepens
frames.note: The long end drifts up three basis points and the front is left where it was. The GBP book reprices; no other curve is built on SONIA, so the work stops there

frames.label: The SONIA messages arrive again
frames.note: A feed reconnect replaying a window it has already sent. Rejected on sequence number, nothing rebuilds

frames.label: SOFR shifts up two basis points
frames.note: Twelve quotes on one curve inside one cycle, coalesced into a single rebuild rather than twelve

frames.label: The meeting dated curve reprices the front end
frames.note: Three basis points around the one year point, with one quote corrected again before the cycle runs

frames.label: The EUR discount curve gaps again
frames.note: Five basis points through the belly. The discount curve rebuilds and carries. The comparison ESTR build takes the same move and its solve fails, so its last good curve is served and marked stale rather than the screen going blank. Nothing prices on it, so the book and the ladders are unaffected

frames.label: The EUR discount curve retraces
frames.note: Three basis points come back out. The comparison curve solves this time, its pending quotes are priced in and the stale mark clears

frames.label: The EURIBOR basis widens a basis point and a half
frames.note: EURIBOR is a projection curve and nothing is built on it, so this moves the book without moving another curve

positions.note: Client business, warehoused. Broken date, odd size, and the desk earns the spread on it.
The desk hedge against the client trade above, in a standard tenor and a round clip. What is left over is the position.
